idea-plugin.name: Chromium Developer Bridge
idea-plugin.description: Inspect and automate a Playwright-managed Chromium from IntelliJ IDEA: live browser preview, DOM inspector, console with source navigation, network table with waterfall, screenshots and visual comparison, session management, and setup for AI coding agents over MCP (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor). The browser driver runs as a separate local process; see the project README.

action.description: Navigate the selected bridge session to a URL
